value.rationale: Source placement on a two-community communication bottleneck is a natural operational invariant. The uniform all-deadline hub source ordering and exact marked crossover at b on the log(a) scale quantify when the bottleneck or leaf-extreme controls completion, including an atom and a sharp mean penalty for starting on the smaller side. This is more than reproducing the known first-order balanced time estimate. Applicability is limited to the stated topology and contact protocol.
